title: fix(console,i18n): a settings source badge reads in the session's language, verb included (objectui#12694)
body:
Fixes #12694
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or type changes)

## What

A settings row's source badge now gets its verb from the console bundle. Each badge is one sentence with the layer's label interpolated as `{{source}}`: `console.settingsView.sourceBadgeInherited` ("Inherited from {{source}}") and `console.settingsView.sourceBadgeOverrides` ("Overrides {{source}}"), translated in all ten packs. `InheritanceBadges` in `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` asks `t()` for them. The layer label is still `sourceText(...)`, which is the server's `settingsCommon.sourceLabels` entry. English output is unchanged.

## Premise, measured on unchanged `main` (`c054d01`) before any edit

Browser reproduction with the real console against a real backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --fresh`, used as a backend only), and this branch's console at `c054d01` under Vite. Steps: sign in as the seeded admin, switch to 中文（中国） from the user menu, save a tenant value (Default country = CN) under Settings, Localization, then reload `/apps/setup/system/settings/localization`.

- before: html `lang="zh-CN"`, badges `["Overrides 默认", "Overrides 默认"]` (the timezone row and the country row)
- after (`6cedffa`, same session, same data): `["覆盖默认", "覆盖默认"]`
- after, switched back to English: `["Overrides Default", "Overrides Default"]`

## Which string table: there are two (the mechanism hypothesis, measured)

The dispatch expected a single table behind both `sourceText(...)` and the page's other copy. There are two:

- `sourceText(...)` is `useSettingsLabel().sourceLabel`. It reads `APP_NS.settingsCommon.sourceLabels.LAYER` from the translations the server serves. objectstack `service-settings` ships them for en, es-ES, ja-JP and zh-CN.
- The page's other chrome (`SettingsView`'s save bar, refusal toasts and back link) reads `console.settingsView.*` from `packages/i18n`, which has ten packs. objectui#4024 set that precedent, including the parameterised `lockedByEnv: 'Locked by environment: {{key}}'`.

The verbs went into the second table, which is the second option in the claim's file surface. The first table is a spec contract. `@objectstack/spec` declares `settingsCommon` a strict object with one member, `sourceLabels`. A verb key there would be refused by the schema that serves it. It would also need an objectstack spec change and would reach only four of the console's ten languages.

## Translations

| pack | Inherited | Overrides |
|---|---|---|
| en | Inherited from {{source}} | Overrides {{source}} |
| zh | 继承自{{source}} | 覆盖{{source}} |
| ja | {{source}}から継承 | {{source}}を上書き |
| ko | {{source}}에서 상속됨 | {{source}} 재정의 |
| de | Geerbt von {{source}} | Überschreibt {{source}} |
| fr | Hérité de {{source}} | Remplace {{source}} |
| es | Heredado de {{source}} | Sobrescribe {{source}} |
| pt | Herdado de {{source}} | Substitui {{source}} |
| ru | Унаследовано: {{source}} | Переопределяет: {{source}} |
| ar | موروث من {{source}} | يتجاوز {{source}} |

`ru` uses the colon form because its verbs govern a case that the server's nominative label cannot take. Japanese and Korean put the layer first, which is why each badge is one interpolated sentence rather than a verb beside a noun.

## Pins

New file: `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.sourceBadgeLocale-12694.test.tsx`. It renders the real `SettingsField` and `useSettingsLabel` under `I18nProvider`, with the server's labels fed through `transformSpecTranslations` the way `loadLanguage.ts` does.

- zh, Overrides and Inherited: neither the badge nor the row header contains a Latin-script letter.
- en, must-not-change: the badge text is exactly `Overrides Default` / `Inherited from Global`.
- every pack: both keys are present with one `{{source}}` hole each, and no non-English pack copies the English.

Red-first, run on the unchanged `SettingsField.tsx` and packs (the prediction is written in the file header and was set before the run): `Tests 12 failed | 2 passed (14)`.

- The zh cases failed with `expected 'Overrides 默认' not to match /\p{Script=Latin}/u` and `expected 'Inherited from 全局' not to match /\p{Script=Latin}/u`.
- The 10 pack cases failed with `expected 'undefined' to be 'string'`.
- The two en cases passed, as predicted, because English is the one language whose output cannot change.

After the change: `Tests 14 passed (14)`.

## Ablations

Run after commit `6cedffa` through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor hit was confirmed, and each restore was proven by blob hash.

- zh pins: both zh pack values replaced by the English sentences. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 11 passed (14)`. The failures were the two zh cases (`expected 'Overrides 默认' ...`, `expected 'Inherited from 全局' ...`) and the zh pack case (`expected 'Inherited from {{source}}' not to be 'Inherited from {{source}}'`). Restored: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- en pin: both en values changed to `Overrides: {{source}}` / `Inherited from: {{source}}`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 12 passed (14)`, with `expected 'Overrides: Default' to be 'Overrides Default'` and `expected 'Inherited from: Global' to be 'Inherited from Global'`. Restored with the same proof.

The root vitest config resolves `@object-ui/i18n` to `packages/i18n/src`, so no rebuild sits between a mutation and its reading.

## Local gates (on `6cedffa`)

- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: 34 of 34 tasks successful
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0 (the console's `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test)
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/ packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 101 passed (101)`, `Tests 1470 passed | 13 skipped (1483)`, exit 0
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 12 changed source files: exit 0 with 0 errors (2 existing `no-explicit-any` warnings elsewhere in `SettingsField.tsx`)
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0
- `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: exit 0 (0 en values changed, 2 keys added)
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 13 paths: NOT GOVERNED

CI runs the rest of the farm.

## Acceptance notes

Seen on the way and not changed here:

- **The env-lock chip is also English.** `EnvLockBadge` draws `Locked by env`, and its fallback tooltip, as literals. Measured on the same stack with `OS_LOCALIZATION_DEFAULT_COUNTRY=CN` on a zh-CN session: the chip reads `Locked by env`, and its tooltip is the server's `Set via env: OS_LOCALIZATION_DEFAULT_COUNTRY`. This is outside this card's file surface and has been reported to the seat for filing.
- The `Deprecated` chip in `FieldHeader` is also a literal. No platform settings manifest declares a deprecated specifier today, so nothing draws it.
- The server ships the layer labels only for en, es-ES, ja-JP and zh-CN. In the console's other six languages the verb is now translated but the label still falls back to English (for example `Überschreibt Default`). That gap is in the server bundle's language coverage, not in this badge.
- `@objectstack/spec` describes `settingsCommon` as covering "source badges, inheritance chips, lock reasons, common actions", but the declared shape has only `sourceLabels`. The declared shape governs, and this change reads no undeclared key.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
